source_text.Q-1042: Acceptance (2): one lever implemented with before/after wall time of the test phase, 5 runs each, run ids. (3) isolation proof. (4) no CI check name changes.

task.description:
WF-03 Step 4 TEST-RUNNER for ISS-1042 (.claude/agents/test-runner.md). Do NOT edit lib/ or test/ code. Two jobs, REAL output only:

JOB A (formal before/after, acceptance 2). BEFORE = a throwaway git worktree OUTSIDE the repo at commit cc65f7b16 (main, no pooled fixture). AFTER = a second throwaway worktree at the branch head (git pull first). In each: deps/_build as needed (copy or mix deps.get; ecto.create/migrate handled by the test alias). Run INTERLEAVED B,A,B,A,... 5 each, the exact CI-shaped slice: MIX_TEST_PARTITION=1 mix test --partitions 12 (no --slowest; same seed 0 for both; same Postgres on port 5499, a throwaway docker postgres you remove afterwards; use the DB config of each worktree). Capture for each run: run id (B1..B5/A1..A5), wall time ('Finished in X seconds' and total elapsed), tests passed/failed, count of LETFLOW_TENANT_FIXTURE outcome=clean|reset|rebuilt log lines for AFTER (a reset-vs-rebuilt ratio; rebuilt should be ~0 in a clean suite). If a run fails, classify (flake vs real) and quote output; do not hide it. Report mean/median/min/max per arm and speedup.

JOB B (scoped gates on the branch head, one invocation each): the three adopter files + test/support/tenant_fixture_dispatch_test.exs + test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_pool_test.exs in one mix test call; then 'MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors'; then 'mix format --check-formatted'.

Write test/reports/report-2026-10-12-WF03-ISS1042-20261012.yaml with the numbers and put the A/B table in docs/issues/ISS-1042.yaml under a 'before_after' key (measurements only; do not flip status). Commit and push (message ends with 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>').

MACHINE RULE (supervisor): only ONE BEAM at a time machine-wide. EVERY mix invocation (each of the 10 runs separately, and each Job B command) must take the mutex, one lock acquisition per mix invocation, wrapper: L=/c/Users/tvolo/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/mixlock; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$L")"; until mkdir "$L" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 20; done; trap 'rmdir "$L" 2>/dev/null' EXIT; cd <dir> && <ONE mix invocation> 2>&1 . A single run may wait a long time for the lock; that wait is excluded from wall time (the timer is mix's own 'Finished in'). Never delete another session's lock. Poll synchronously: foreground calls only, split with timeouts under 10 min (a BEAM that needs more than the tool timeout must be run so the call blocks; if a single call can time out, run it with nohup to a log in the scratchpad INSIDE the lock-holding wrapper script and poll the log with short foreground sleeps; never arm Monitors). Clean up worktrees and container at the end; git status clean.
acceptance_criteria: 10 timed runs with ids and real output

result.summary: 10/10 timed runs green, 0 discarded. Finished-in mean before 367.9s vs after 256.2s (1.44x, -30.4%); median 370.7 vs 251.0. Scoped gates: 161 passed 0 failures, compile --warnings-as-errors clean, format clean. 1 expected rebuilt/run (pool test drift probe), 78 resets.
